blocks.text: BAGUIO CITY — Transport group Piston Metro Baguio protested the World Bank-led transport modernization convention at Baguio’s Venus Park Hotel, an hour before talks began. Piston reiterated its opposition to abolishing traditional jeepneys, including Euro 4-compliant units, as the government pushes for a shift to electric vehicles under its public transport modernization program. Students and youth members led by Anakbayan joined a protest rally in solidarity with jeepney drivers and operators opposing the mandatory replacement of their vehicles.
